adapters.label: Cross-species breakpoint detection
adapters.description: Comparative breakpoint catalog across 18 catfish species. Two independent method families (gene-order via BUSCO; sequence via wfmash) feed cluster_breakpoints.py with a cross_method flag set only when families agree. BP_ATLAS adds BP3c reciprocity. Headline: LG27 bounded inversion (12.43 Mb + 16.50 Mb both edges cross-method validated); LG23 @ 4.04 Mb cross-method; LG28 @ 15-19 Mb recurrent gene-order-only.

packages.label: Discovery + karyotype (coupled)
packages.description: Three coupled analyses that take raw window-band / L3 / dosage signals through to polarised per-sample karyotype calls. Standalone but tightly chained: candidate_registry → unpolarized_karyotype_calls → polarized_karyotype_calls. Sibling adapters share the same input scope but each is its own registry entry.
